title: 36" Counter-Depth French Door Refrigerator with External Dispenser
sub: RISE design, stainless steel, ice and water at the door
lead: JennAir's RISE design in stainless steel, at counter depth: ice and filtered water at the door, a black Obsidian interior lit by LEDs, and a full-width pantry drawer you set for wine, deli, drinks or meat.

features.name: Obsidian interior, lit from every side
features.line: A black interior with LED lighting at several points and a halo light along the top, so food stands out and nothing hides in a dark corner.

features.name: Ice and water at the door
features.line: Cubed or crushed ice and filtered water without opening a door, with Measured Fill for an exact amount and a lock for small hands.

features.name: A pantry drawer with four settings
features.line: A full-width drawer you set for wine, deli, beverages or meat.

features.name: Room for the tall and the odd
features.line: Half of one glass shelf folds back for a tall pitcher or a cake, a rack under a shelf holds up to three bottles, and a pull-out tray sits above the crispers.

features.name: Remote access
features.line: Change temperatures and get alerts for a door left open, a power outage or a filter that's due, from the JennAir app or by voice with Alexa or Google Assistant. It needs Wi-Fi and the app, and voice works in the US only.

also: Water filter included, certified to NSF/ANSI 42, 53 and 401 to reduce up to 75 contaminants
Four sensors watch the fresh-food, pantry and freezer temperatures and the room's
Soft, self-closing freezer and inner drawers
Adaptive defrost, which runs only when needed
specs: Stainless steel, stainless steel handles; Obsidian black interior
Dispenser on the door: cubed and crushed ice, filtered water, Measured Fill; ice maker in the door
1 fixed full-width glass, 4 adjustable half-width glass (one folds back)
Full-width temperature-controlled pantry drawer; 2 humidity-controlled crispers, 60/40
Wi-Fi with the JennAir app; Alexa and Google Assistant
71 7/8 × 35 5/8 × 32 3/8 in; 70 7/8 in to the top of the cabinet
